name: Transgression triggers Vampiric Feast on direct spell damage (#6651)
contract: Transgression 801076 (Rank 'Cursed Form') reads: 'Enter a unique Cursed Form for $d that does not disable
the use of Mortal Form abilities. While active, direct spell damage triggers a Vampiric Feast, dealing
$801076s3% additional Shadow damage to enemies, healing you equal to 50% of the damage dealt.' Spell.dbc
gives effect 3 (EFFECT_2) SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354, BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = the 20%
the tooltip renders, and TriggerSpell Vampiric Feast 804934 (SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH, EffectValueMultiplier
0.5 the '50% of the damage dealt' heal, SchoolMask 32 Shadow, SpellFamilyName 26). Aura 354 has no entry in
AuraEffectHandler and no case in AuraEffect::HandleProc, and 801076 carries ProcFlags 0, so no spell_proc
row was ever generated, Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 and the clause never fired. This scenario casts
one direct damage spell without the form and then the same spell under it: the Feast must not exist before,
and must appear after. The 20% share and the 50% leech are the trigger's own data and are not re-derived here.
